title: Elite affix
description: One of the twelve champion affixes an Elite room's promoted monster carries on its nameplate (03-GAME-DESIGN §11.1; the table of 06-MONSTERS.md §2). One file per affix under content/elite-affixes/<id>.json; monsters list the ones they may spawn with in elitePool. The promotion itself (HP ×2.5, gold ×3, XP class +2, parts rolled twice) is a rule of the champion, carried here as multipliers so the sim reads one record.

affixClass.description: The composition class (06 §2): a champion carries at most one defensive and one control affix; the rest are offensive.

rule.description: The rule as 06 §2 words it; the sim implements it from the effects and, where those cannot say it, by this affix's id.

effects.description: Lines the champion gains: stat buffs (Rabid: speed and attackPhys), on-hit statuses (Shackler: root 50%), auras and bursts as custom lines named by the affix id.

hpMultiplier.description: On top of the template's HP multiplier (06 §2: every champion ×2.5).

goldMultiplier.description: On top of the template's gold multiplier (06 §2: ×3).

xpClassBonus.description: Added to the template's XP class (06 §2: +2).

floorMin.description: The first floor of the dungeon it may roll on (06 §2: the five teaching affixes from F1, the rest from F3).

tell.description: A one-turn visible cue before the affix's dangerous beat (Spiteful: it swells); null when it has none.

excludesElement.description: Warded: the chosen immunity never matches the template's weakness.
